A [[Bolt of Linen]] is a rare crafting material.  It is used in the crafting of a number of armor sets. 

==Acquisition==
* Purchased from [[rare material trader]]s.
* Select Prophecies [[artisan]]s will craft one Bolt of Linen for 5 [[Plant Fiber]]s and 200 {{gold}}.
* [[Expert Salvage Kit|Expert salvaged]] from:
** Armor crafted with Bolts of Linen.
** See [[:Category:Contains linen]] for other items.
* For known [[creature]]s that [[drop]] Bolts of Linen see [[:Category:Drops linen]].
